leadText: Yasuyuki Kase (Japanese: 加瀬康之 Kase Yasuyuki) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Yasuyuki Kase (Japanese: 加瀬康之 Kase Yasuyuki) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Kase was born on Mar 14, 1971 in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined during the nineteenth movie, where he voiced Levi, one of the main antagonists. In , Kase gained his most notable role as Guzma, the leader of Team Skull. Kase is currently affiliated with the talent agency Office Osawa.
